summary: CleanSpark's indirect subsidiary CSDC Finance I, LLC completed a previously announced private offering of 7.875% senior secured notes due 2031, raising $2,276.0 million at 98.500% of par plus accrued interest. Proceeds fund the Sandersville, Georgia data center, reimburse prior equity contributions, and fund debt service reserves. Notes are guaranteed by CSRE Properties Sandersville and secured by collateral under a U.S. Bank indenture, with semi-annual amortization tied to a target project debt service coverage ratio. Interest pays April 1 and October 1; maturity October 1, 2031. Watch collateral coverage and project execution risk.
